archetype: Academic Night Mode (Luxury + Neon Accent Hybrid)

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-display text-white
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-display text-orange-50
rules.lesson_text: text-lg md:text-xl leading-loose font-body text-orange-50 max-w-3xl mx-auto

anti_patterns: Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Do not default to bold for Michroma, let the font's natural width provide weight.
Do not center-align lesson body text; always left-align for K-12 readability.

rules: Orange on Maroon contrast requires care. Use orange primarily for borders, icons, buttons, and progress rings. For orange text on maroon, ensure high luminance (use #FF9D42 if #FA8720 fails APCA).
Button text on an Orange primary background MUST be #1A0000 (Deepest Maroon) to ensure readable contrast.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF). All darks are maroon-tinted, all lights are warm-tinted.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, Immersive Focus

bento_grid.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2. Use for Founder Story + Stats.
bento_grid.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use for Subject/Course grids.

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

ambient_design.concept: Soft glow, subtle line accents, no overdone effects.
ambient_design.implementation: Cards use bg-[#380101] with border border-[#5C1A1A]. Active/Mastery cards add shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(250,135,32,0.15)] and border-[#FA8720]/30.
ambient_design.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the auto-hiding top banner: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#1A0000]/70 border-b border-[#5C1A1A].

components.auto_hiding_banner: Fixed top, fades out on scroll down, fades in on hover/scroll up. Contains COPPA compliance badge for K-5 and basic nav.
components.collapsible_sidebar: Smooth width transition. Uses lucide-react icons. 1px right border (#5C1A1A).
components.lesson_reader: max-w-3xl mx-auto, text-lg Outfit font, generous line height. Pass/Mastery states show yellow/orange glowing borders.
components.ai_helper_sidebar: Distinct from main layout. 'Discuss dont answer' UI. Uses pulsing orange dot for thinking state. Border left #5C1A1A.
components.focus_mode: In-app timer. When active, blocks navigation. UI shifts to pure #1A0000 void with a massive, perfectly circular glowing orange timer ring. No distractions.
components.parental_controls: Data-dense Shadcn tables. Tighter grid, less gamification. Focus on utility and metrics.

rules: No universal transitions (transition: all is banned).
Staggered entrance animations for subject grids.
Hover states: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and glow opacity increase.
Focus Mode toggle: smooth fade-to-dark immersive transition.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #FA8720 passes against #380101. Add text-shadow or brighten to #FFB067 if used for critical small text.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for AI pulsing and Focus mode transitions.

image_urls.description: Student in dark setting using laptop (Hero or Founder Story background)
Two individuals in a dark room (Perfect for parent-led or tutor-matched UI)
Abstract orange geometry (Use for ambient textures, empty states, or mastery badges)

rules: Image overlays must be #1A0000/60 to match the maroon theme.
Never use pure black or white overlays.
Use mix-blend-luminosity or opacity to sink images into the dark maroon background.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth UI transitions and AI thinking states. 3D libraries (R3F) are not required unless gamified tutor ranks require an interactive 3D badge (Spline recommended if so).

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind config with the specified color palette (#1A0000 base, #380101 surface, #FA8720 primary).
Build the layout shell with a collapsible sidebar and auto-hiding top banner.
Implement the Learn module with Bento Grids for subjects and an immersive, left-aligned reader for lessons.
Ensure the AI Helper sidebar visually feels like a separate layer (border-l, slight shadow).
Build 'Focus Mode' as a high-z-index overlay or a layout shift that hides all non-essential UI.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark maroon surfaces.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect K-12 reading flow (left-aligned text).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or perfectly rounded pill) with interaction animations.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
